patch.value: GH-1484: Infer native Node test telemetry and bound intentional test flush lifetime

GitHub #1484 reports that SDK package suites using node --test inherit NODE_TEST_CONTEXT=child-v8 without Vitest flags or NODE_ENV=test. Current inference omits that signal, so child CLI invocations can be recorded as ordinary activity. The report also describes an ENOTEMPTY cleanup race with a detached telemetry worker. Source inspection confirms the missing signal in consent and inline-flush selection; the reported cleanup race is not reproduced by this intake.

Native Node test children are inferred before identity creation, storage or export; explicit test-event consent and source-context overrides retain their documented behavior; intentional test delivery has a bounded worker lifetime and cleanup proof; ordinary production delivery and the existing deleted-root guard remain covered; Node and Bun package consumers have published-SDK regression evidence and updated configuration guidance.

Read the current consent, source-context, Sentry and flush-worker policies and predecessor evidence. Choose a scoped native-test signal and intentional-delivery lifecycle policy, with isolated loopback and real child-process controls.
